Noor Alvi: Hey team! Noor here (she/they)  joined Visual Design today. Im into sourdough experiments, urban beekeeping (still learning), and terrible crossword solving. Excited to meet yall :honey_pot: :bread:
Jae Kim: welcome Noor!! beekeeping = legendary. bring pics if you have them. Also there's a welcome coffee tomorrow at 10am in the lounge :coffee:
Maya Ortiz: hi Noor  welcome! quick logistic q: any allergies for lunch? also are you remote or in-office mostly? we do a weekly design critique on Tuesdays if you want to join 
Noor Alvi: thanks! no allergies. planning hybrid (Tues/Thurs in office). happily join critiques 
reception-bot: Badge request received. Noor Alvis badge will be at reception for pickup after 9:30am. Temporary desk: 4F-Design hotdesk B2. Beek-friendly locker options noted. 
Eli Tran: welcome! tiny tip: there's a beard-trim/helmet sticker in the inbox for bike commuters (if you cycle with a hive crate). Also we sometimes do a sourdough swap on Fridays 
Noor Alvi: omg a sourdough swap?! adding myself. Also Ill bring photos of my shaky swarm box next week 
Jae Kim: added you to the critique invite. see you Tuesday and for coffee tomorrow :tada:
Noor Alvi: thanks everyone  excited to be here :raised_hands:
